summary: Full backend + frontend testing for the Unified GA4 + Clarity analytics dashboard in DEMO mode. 19/19 pytest backend tests pass covering health, credentials (status/save/delete/validation), landing-pages CRUD (create+GET+PATCH+DELETE persistence), analytics summary, overview (default 30d + custom range + 404), GA4 traffic-sources / devices / countries, realtime, clarity and compare. Frontend Dashboard, Landing Pages (list + create dialog), LP Detail (KPIs, traffic chart, realtime, tabs: Sources/Frustration/Sessions/Geography), Compare and Settings pages all load, render deterministic demo data correctly, and show GA4/Clarity DEMO badges. No runtime errors, no MongoDB _id leakage, no overlay/focus issues.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~760 lines; consider splitting into routers (credentials, landing_pages, analytics) and a helpers module for maintainability (soft, non-blocking).
analytics_summary_all sequentially awaits GA4+Clarity per LP. For real credentialed mode this can be slow with many LPs; consider asyncio.gather fan-out.
Clarity cache key uses only (lp_id, days) so cached results won't refresh if credentials change until TTL elapses (2h). Consider invalidating on credential save/delete.
FastAPI @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') is deprecated in recent versions; migrate to lifespan context (non-blocking).
test_credentials: N/A (no auth in app; DEMO mode)
seed_data_creation: Backend auto-seeds 3 LPs (Pricing Page, Product Launch — Fall 2025, Free Trial Signup) on first startup. UI test creates and cleans up a TEST_Smoke_LP_UI via the API.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Re-running backend tests: `REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=<prod-url> pytest /app/backend/tests/test_analytics_api.py -v`. All analytics endpoints fall back to deterministic demo data when GA4/Clarity credentials are missing, so totals are stable per URL+date. Credentials endpoints are idempotent; tests clean up at the end. The app has no auth. MongoDB seeds on startup only when the landing_pages collection is empty.
